44 Tickets Sold

Enter Now

You may enter the competition using the postal entry route by complying with the following conditions:

 

  1. Register online
  2. Send your entry on an unenclosed postcard by first or second class prepaid post to the Promoter at the following address: 198 Morrison Drive, Aberdeen, Scotland, AB10 7HD
  3. Include with your entry the following information:
    • Your full name
    • Your address
    • A contact telephone number and email address
    • Your chosen competition

You can enter as many times as you wish into the same Competition, up to the maximum stated on the Competition Page, but each free entry must be submitted and posted to the Promoter separately. Bulk entries will not be accepted as multiple entries and if a bulk entry is received, it will be counted as one single entry.

Incomplete or illegible entries will be disqualified.

 

See the T&Cs Schedule 1 to learn more about free postal entry.

How to play

Join the draw
01

Buy a ticket through our website - or use the free entry postal route by sending us a postcard with your details (see schedule 1 to the T&Cs). The paid and free entry routes have equal chances of winning.

Watch live draw
02

Check the main prize page for the draw date and time. For live draws tune into our socials to watch the draw live. For auto & manual Draws the prize page will announce the winner automatically. Make sure to check in to discover if you’re the lucky winner. The anticipation is part of the fun!

Receive your prize
03

We’ll organise receival of our Winners prizes! Share your happiness with our community by sending us a photo of you and your prize, which we’ll feature on our website.
